analogs.class: GABA benzodiazepine site receptor inverse agonist

analogy.rationale: These cells express little to no GABA-A receptor subunits or TSPO, so a benzodiazepine receptor antagonist should produce essentially no transcriptional response; the closest reference classes are other GABA/benzodiazepine-site ligands, which likewise act on receptors largely absent here.
